races.name: Download The At The Races App Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIGLESISBACK is favoured by these terms so she's preferred to the 3 penalised winners, with Myluckymaker feared most of that trio.

  1. BIGLESISBACK
  2. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  3. TRALEE GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BRYSON had more in hand than the bare margin suggests when winning on his second start for this yard at Uttoxeter on Friday so looks capable of defying a penalty. The thriving Littletown Lad is the obvious threat, while Malangen holds solid place prospects once again.

  1. BRYSON (IRE)
  2. LITTLETOWN LAD (IRE)
  3. MALANGEN (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KOOL RAOUL begins the new campaign off a decent mark and ran well first time up last season. He gets the nod. Conquer The Breeze and Well Educated are also of interest.

  1. KOOL RAOUL (FR)
  2. CONQUER THE BREEZE (IRE)
  3. WELL EDUCATED (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CODED WELDER is still a maiden but he's unexposed as a stayer and is taken to strike with the return to a longer trip likely to suit. Do No Wrong is entitled to strip fitter for his recent comeback and may be the one to follow the selection home.

  1. CODED WELDER (IRE)
  2. DO NO WRONG (IRE)
  3. BLAKEY BOY (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JERIKO DU REPONET has yet to match his smart hurdles form over fences, but he shaped well under some considerate rides last season and this looks a good opportunity for him to shed his maiden status in this sphere. Royal Infantry was well held on his sole previous chase start but is surely capable of better for the in-form Skeltons.

  1. JERIKO DU REPONET (FR)
  2. ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE)
  3. WELONLYHAVEDONE (IRE)

races.name: Northumbria Leisure Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
LUMINARIES remains well treated on old form so can complete a quick-fire hat-trick back over fences. Stay Hopeful is the obvious threat if turned out quickly, while Super Citizen is also respected back on a winning mark.

  1. LUMINARIES (IRE)
  2. STAY HOPEFUL (IRE)
  3. SUPER CITIZEN

races.name: Join Moulton Racing Syndicate Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks easier than the race PIETRO was third in at the Doncaster St Leger meeting and he can resume winning ways. Yarmouth specialist Gorgeous Mr George is feared most ahead of the ultra-consistent Korbut.

  1. PIETRO (IRE)
  2. GORGEOUS MR GEORGE (IRE)
  3. KORBUT

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A maiden to keep a close eye on moving forward with some excellent pedigrees/yards on show. CLOAK OF POWER is bred in the purple and holds a Group 1 entry, so she edges the vote before market clues. Usaylah seems sure to build on her debut promise for a yard with an excellent recent record in this race, while Marylebone and Antonova are 2 other very appealing debutants to take seriously.

  1. CLOAK OF POWER (IRE)
  2. MARYLEBONE (FR)
  3. ANTONOVA

races.name: Graham & Alison's 15th Wedding Aniversary Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STARSHIP LILY was much improved from debut when second of 4 at Wolverhampton 15 days ago and, with the further drop in trip promising to suit, she's taken to make it third time lucky. Oliaku hasn't been seen since failing to justify short odds on her Yarmouth debut back in May 2025 but still ought to prove capable of better given she was a 6-figure breeze-up purchase.

  1. STARSHIP LILY (IRE)
  2. OLIAKU
  3. MARCH OF TIME (IRE)

races.name: Gold And Silver Exchange Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LADY MAGU made it back-to-back wins when scoring in good style at Wolverhampton last time and, with her turf success coming on soft ground, she is taken to land the hat-trick with conditions promising to suit. She gets the vote ahead of Queen of Scotland, who also arrives having won her last 2 starts, with Arrivera another to consider.

  1. LADY MAGU
  2. QUEEN OF SCOTLAND
  3. ARRIVERA

races.name: Seadell Shops & Holiday Chalets Handicap
races.verdict:
POTTERS PRINCE is well treated under a penalty for last week's 1m course success and can follow up under Oisin Murphy. The hat-trick-seeking Give Me Sun is second choice ahead of Divot, who scored twice over C&D during the summer.

  1. POTTERS PRINCE
  2. GIVE ME SUN
  3. DIVOT

races.name: Infobond Turnkey & Personnel Services Handicap
races.verdict:
PIXIE DIVA should be sharper with a recent outing under her belt and is too well handicapped to ignore under Oisin Murphy. Kinetic Force and Billy Loughnane's mount Fiorella Princess are others who could go well, while the class-dropping Marching Mac would be a threat to all if the ground goes on the soft side.

  1. PIXIE DIVA
  2. KINETIC FORCE
  3. FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)

races.name: Brandford Restaurants & Bar Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This looks between penalised winners WODAO and Rambuso Creek, with the former preferred having got himself firmly back on track when a comfortable winner at Redcar on Friday. Dashing Donkey and My Boy Harry can battle for minor honours.

  1. WODAO (FR)
  2. RAMBUSO CREEK (IRE)
  3. DASHING DONKEY

races.name: Brandford Restaurants & Bar Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
KOFFEE AND KALE is taken to gain compensation for his Yarmouth near miss and secure a deserved first success of 2026. Call Time rates a big threat on the back of an excellent recent Nottingham second, while Rory's Royale can also play a prominent role in his bid for a maiden victory.

  1. KOFFEE AND KALE
  2. CALL TIME (IRE)
  3. RORY'S ROYALE

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SEA LA ROMA's debut second at Yarmouth was full of promise and with this step up in distance sure to suit this Group 1-entered filly, she can find the necessary improvement to see off Empress Jingu. Al Afaweeq's pedigree is a very appealing one and the market may tell a story on debut.

  1. SEA LA ROMA (IRE)
  2. EMPRESS JINGU
  3. AL AFAWEEQ (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A useful handicap with OURSIN an appealing candidate. He hasn't stood much racing so far but looks an all-weather natural and on the back of a gelding operation, he may well up his game. Ernst Blofeld, Circus of Rome and Wardlaw are solid rivals.

  1. OURSIN
  2. ERNST BLOFELD (IRE)
  3. CIRCUS OF ROME

races.name: All-Weather Championships Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
NEWSREADER has gained all 3 wins on all-weather and has shaped well on 2 of 3 starts for Tony Carroll. He looks the answer, for all Get Up Everybody and Rousham have something to recommend them.

  1. NEWSREADER (IRE)
  2. GET UP EVERYBODY (IRE)
  3. ROUSHAM

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DALAMARA is a filly in form and hasn't been harshly treated by the handicapper for her recent course victory. She may be able to follow up. Sandy Craic and Boubyan may provide the chief threat.

  1. DALAMARA
  2. SANDY CRAIC (IRE)
  3. BOUBYAN (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SECOND FIDDLE is back on her last winning mark and looked unlucky not to finish closer here last week. She makes fair appeal. Shes Got The Blues and Bajan Bandit should also go well.

  1. SECOND FIDDLE (IRE)
  2. SHES GOT THE BLUES (IRE)
  3. BAJAN BANDIT

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict:
BLACK FURY upped her game at Beverley last time and looks on a workable mark for her nursery bow. She gets the nod. Northern Viola and Notimetotakeoff rate the principal dangers.

  1. BLACK FURY (IRE)
  2. NORTHERN VIOLA
  3. NOTIMETOTAKEOFF (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
BRAZEN IDOL backed up his previous effort when only narrowly denied here 8 days ago and he could be ready to take advantage of his reduced mark. Heading the list of dangers is Opal Storm, who arrives on the back of her fourth win of the campaign, with Ashen also in the mix.

  1. BRAZEN IDOL
  2. OPAL STORM
  3. ASHEN (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for POCKLEY, who left behind his first 2 efforts of the season when making the frame here 4 days ago. The 10-time course winner is taken to build on that effort to add to his tally, with Spirited Dancer feared most having shaped well in 2 starts for her current yard. Auntie Jo completes the shortlist.

  1. POCKLEY
  2. SPIRITED DANCER
  3. AUNTIE JO

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SPEEDING BULLET has worked his way back to form this season, shaping as if a step back up to 6f would suit when second at Pontefract last time, so he could be set to strike from 5 lb below his last winning mark. Macedonian is next on the list on the back of going close over this C&D, ahead of Mayo County.

  1. SPEEDING BULLET (IRE)
  2. MACEDONIAN (IRE)
  3. MAYO COUNTY

races.name: 1xBet.ie Supporting October Racing Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
Probably not a strong maiden for the course, with SONNY HAYES taken to build on a promising first run at Cork and open his account. Nation Blaze should have a race in him, while Aidan O'Brien's pair Major Triumph and newcomer Tabasco River have to be respected.

  1. SONNY HAYES (IRE)
  2. NATION BLAZE (IRE)
  3. MAJOR TRIUMPH (IRE)

races.name: Autumn Racing With 1xBet.ie At The Curragh Handicap
races.verdict:
MERISI DIAMOND has quickly dropped to 2 lb below the mark he defied here in the spring and is worth siding with under Dylan Browne McMonagle. Second choice is Nouvel Espoir, who has been in cracking form since the start of the summer and also has the services of a top jockey. All The Girls is well handicapped on all-weather form and is also shortlisted along with Tolebi.

  1. MERISI DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. NOUVEL ESPOIR (IRE)
  3. ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)

races.name: Bill Hanlon Memorial Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien's TOGETHER NOW holds the edge on form and is taken to gain a deserved breakthrough success at the chief expense of Sounds Great, who should find this longer trip to her benefit. Hey Stella and I Hope You Dance appeal as the pick of the remainder.

  1. TOGETHER NOW (USA)
  2. SOUNDS GREAT (IRE)
  3. HEY STELLA (IRE)

races.name: Staffordstown Stud Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
MAIRE RUA is a filly on the up and had several of these rivals behind her when scoring at Leopardstown last month. She can follow up. Golden Ring and Isle of Capri are feared most.

  1. MAIRE RUA
  2. GOLDEN RING (IRE)
  3. ISLE OF CAPRI (IRE)

races.name: Every Race, Every Moment 1xBet.ie Amateur Riders Derby (Q.R.) Race
races.verdict:
ABSURDE was never involved back from a break here last month but stands out on form and is the one to beat. Last year's winner Sirius and the lightly-raced Contorsion may give him most to think about.

  1. ABSURDE (FR)
  2. SIRIUS (FR)
  3. CONTORSION (USA)

races.name: 1xBet.ie Supports The Curragh Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for KHORMOR SYD, who figures off a handy mark and didn't get the clearest of runs on his return to action here last week. Mr Perth, African Affair and Kodi Brown complete the shortlist in what looks an open contest.

  1. KHORMOR SYD (IRE)
  2. MR PERTH (IRE)
  3. AFRICAN AFFAIR (IRE)

races.name: Always Gambling Responsibly With 1xBet.ie Handicap
races.verdict:
MYTHICAL ROCK signalled he is ready to double his tally when runner-up at Bellewstown last time and with that form having been well advertised since he gets the nod. La Tulipe Noire caught the eye when sixth here recently and could emerge as the main danger from a falling mark, although Jasmine Affanalis, Zipster and No More Porter all need factoring into this very open handicap too.

  1. MYTHICAL ROCK (IRE)
  2. LA TULIPE NOIRE (IRE)
  3. JASMINE AFFANALIS (IRE)
